component.title: MOSAIC Brain Software Recipe Model
component.role: Domain model for capability ingredients, operations, execution context, outputs, evaluation and evolution, integrated into existing MOSAIC Brain.

doe.promotion_rule: held-out confirmation + independent evidence; no automatic promotion

integration.commit_replay: consumer/adapter only; no reimplementation of fragment index, compose, symbol resolution, or surgical edit primitives
integration.monorepo_brain: compose through existing typed reasoning kernel; do not create another brain
integration.mosaic_brain: owned domain capability under methodology_intelligence; advisory only

governance.registration_requires: MOSAIC Brain owner + CRG owner + DoE expert + Linguist review and existing Delphi admission
governance.evaluation: separate component context; no cross-component aggregate score
governance.promotion: human-governed; no automatic merge, deploy, or permission expansion
